9. Āyācitabhattajātaka The Vowed Feast: a past life story

“Sace mucce pecca mucce, If you would be released, after death might you be released, Muccamāno hi bajjhati; because releasing binds. Na hevaṁ dhīrā muccanti, That’s not how the attentive are released; Mutti bālassa bandhanan”ti. such release is the fool’s bondage.

Āyācitabhattajātakaṁ navamaṁ.
